question:
By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct?

4 and 6
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] According to the question, by **Interchanging the given two numbers i.e '4 and 6'**: So, __ • Option - (1) : 4 ÷ 2 + 3 - 6 × 5 = -14 **6 ÷ 2**__ + 3 - 4 × 5 = -14 3 + 3 - __**4**____** × 5**__ = -14 __**3 + 3**__ - 20 = -14
